spans.text: On the outskirts of Berlin.
By a road lined with verdant trees stands a small and rather decrepit house.
(Wheezes) What's with this rickety house?! This can't be the place that J guy is sending us to, right?
Stop complaining and get to work, SOP-II.
Alright, alright!
This place looks so beat-up. Can it even be used?
It does look a bit old, but it's actually quite well-equipped. There's even a vehicle for us.
Oh! Hold on, why are we the only ones doing the cleaning?!
We'd already be done by now if you hadn't wasted so much time jabbering.
RO635 picks up their cleaning equipment and pushes SOP-II into the house.
The others remain outside, organizing their ammo and firearm reserves. Everyone looks solemn and exhausted.
I can see from your face that you've already come up with thousands of ways of dealing with Morridow.
If you can't hold it in, do share them with me. I'm sure your ideas will be way more hair-raising than Gr G11's horror flicks.
I know how you feel, 15, but Morridow may still be of use to us.
I understand, Commander.
It won't be easy getting information out of her.
How hard can it be? I can get her to talk as long as she has a mouth.
I also know how to conduct an interrogation, but the main problem is we're only safe for the time being.
Even with the temporary safe house, with Morridow's skills, it's only a matter of time for her to break through the signal barrier and get a message out.
If we don't solve this issue, we'll have to keep switching locations.
If Paradeus takes her away, all our efforts will have been for nothing...
Can't you break her comms module?
It won't do any good. Only an electronic lock would work on her.
Unfortunately, the only person who can create one... is still in dreamland.
Then when will she be able to do that?
Break through the signal barrier, I mean.
Hard to say. After all, a Nyto's neural cloud... or virtual cognition image?
Well, it may look like our neural space, but it's actually a completely different system.
I can try hacking it, but my method would be rather crude.
In that case—
Screeeeeee—
At that moment, an extraordinary noise suddenly comes through the Commander's communicator.
The shrill shriek pierces the Commander's human eardrums. The two Dolls are also displaying reactions of intense pain.
Argh...!!
It's... a neural attack...!!
ST AR-15 collapses onto the ground, her limbs spasming out of control.
UMP45 is faring a lot better in comparison, but even she is struggling to move.
The Commander hurriedly turns off the communicator and stares at the collapsed ST AR-15 in alarm.
Dammit! We're already under attack?!
G-Get out of here... Commander...!
The Commander, the only one unaffected, is caught in a dilemma.
They can't just leave the Dolls behind!
Screeeeee!!
Oof!
The sharp noise rings out again, and UMP45, who was frozen to the spot just a second ago, is released from her invisible binds.
Ugh...!
The spasming ST AR-15 also returns to normal, but she is still sprawled on the ground from the exertion.
I have never come across EM interference of such intensity...
Still shaken, UMP45 grips her gun warily.
We must...Prepare for a counterattack... Where is the enemy?
Leaning against a wall, ST AR-15 gets to her feet feebly as she scans the surroundings cautiously.
However, throughout the initial neural attack, the safe house has been utterly still and quiet.
The enemies everyone is expecting have not shown up. UMP45 and ST AR-15 exchange bemused glances.
What on earth just happened?
...Are both of you alright?
...I'm okay now.
I took a hit, but it only lasted a second.
Still feeling very tense and uneasy, UMP45 gets in touch with UMP9.
9? Respond if you copy.
45? What is it?
Did you feel anything just now?
No?
UMP9 is her usual self. Nothing seems to have happened to her whatsoever.
Did they not notice anything?
Looks like it. I suppose the phenomenon was localized to where we are?
Localized...
Suddenly struck by a thought, ST AR-15 turns to look at the entrance of the safe house.
Crap! RO and SOP-II!
WAAAAH!!!
As if to confirm ST AR-15's suspicions, SOP-II's scream comes from within the safe house.
On a shaded boulevard, an oblivious moth lands lightly on Gray. She pinches its wings delicately.
Then she brings her hands gently together...And slowly pushes them against each other... She spreads her hands...
And the moth is now lifeless.
W-We... couldn't lock onto their latest position...
We have already deployed all our scouts, but Morridow's signal was very weak...
T-Then we lost it altogether several minutes ago. We can't trace it...
Save the explanation.
What about you?
The Nyto being addressed shudders and answers carefully.
We cracked the data from the previous transmission. They seem to point towards these locations.
Right. Send me the floor plans of all three factories.
They have been sent to you...
But these factories are all abandoned... W-What do we do next?
Find something from the factories and put them in there. Make sure they're less than 50% complete.
...Understood.
You.
Gray raises her chin.
A-awaiting orders!
Go and set up a surveillance system. Don't leave any blind spots.
Yes, ma'am!
But...
Go on.
The place has been abandoned for too long, I'm afraid the power supply will not be able to support the surveillance equipment...
That's fine. We still have time.
Should I... send sentries over there?
No need. I'm going in person.
Yes, ma'am.
After a pause, Gray tosses the corpse of the moth away.
The Nytos look at each other... uncertain whether they should leave. Gray glances at them.
Get to work.
Yes, Ma'am.
The Nytos take their leave, and Gray lets out a long sigh.
She dials someone's number on her communicator.
...You look dog tired.
I am. I just hope it will go smoothly this time.
It's just been trouble after trouble. Tell those at Galatea to take better care.
Thank goodness we have you.
...If only she'd think so as well.
She'll probably be able to tell...
But who cares about her? She'll have to ask for my help eventually.
The "goods" are still with me, after all.
True.
I'm almost done on my end.
Good. I'll see you later.
In the house on the outskirts of Berlin.
SOP-II!!!
ST-AR 15 kicks open the door and calls out to her friend anxiously.
Oh boy.

The two Dolls are immediately greeted by the sight of SOP-II and RO635 sprawled on the ground as they enter the house. Unlike themselves, these two have clearly crashed right away when they came under attack.
UMP45 rushes up to them and starts running diagnostics, while ST AR-15 runs over to Dandelion, who has been laid down on the sofa.
Seemingly oblivious to all the commotion, she is just lying there silently. ST AR-15 leans in to inspect her carefully—if anyone is launching an attack, the one they must protect is...
Hold on, 15!
What?
Just as ST AR-15 freezes in confusion, her hand is suddenly caught in a grip.
She turns her head in surprise and finds herself staring into a pair of familiar eyes. Dandelion is gazing at her with her eyes wide open.
Wha—
...What is it, 15?
Is something wrong with your language module?
UMP45 and the Commander stand rooted to the spot, utterly shocked by the sudden development.
Dande... No... Who exactly are...
...Don't be alarmed, 15.
Is this another one of Dandelion's stupid jokes?
No, this isn't Dandelion.
You're...M4...
M4 pats ST AR-15 on the head and peers at the gobsmacked Commander.
Aren't you going to say hello, Commander?
Uh... Yeah. Oh, uh...
You...
Being addressed directly all of a sudden leaves the Commander completely flustered.
But M4 seems content to just gaze affectionately at an old friend whom she hasn't seen in a long time.
Looking deep into her eyes, the baffled Commander slowly regains their composure.
...Welcome back, M4.
By now, no one can doubt her identity.
...So that neural attack was your doing?
While the others are all caught in the emotional moment, UMP45 is hanging on the sideline, the very image of annoyance.
And here we thought Paradeus was onto us.
Sorry, I didn't know my awakening would have that side effect.
...That's alright, I'm not fishing for an apology from you.
However, could you revive those two first?
Oh, of course...
M4 sits up on the sofa and puts her feet down on the floor. She stares at Dandelion's legs, seemingly struck by the curious feeling of using an unfamiliar body.
Both the Commander and ST AR-15 are visibly concerned as they watch her uncertain movements, causing M4 to chuckle.
I'm not a patient in rehab.
You don't have to fret so much, 15, Commander.
But you...
C'mon, she looks a lot better than you did just now.
I may just be an outsider, but even I can tell you're making her uncomfortable.
You are not an outsider, 45.
There isn't a single outsider here. You are our cherished companion.
...That's right, 45. Stop saying such things.
Humph.
UMP45 shrugs and does not bother to argue. But her face looks visibly more relaxed.
M4 walks slowly up to RO635 and SOP-II, who are lying on the floor.
What?!
The crashed Dolls leap up instantly.
W-What just happened?!
Huh?! M4! M4 is awake!!
Dandelion?!
M4 smiles apologetically.
Could you get everyone outside for now?
I need to have a word with the Commander in private.
Huh?! But why?! I also wanna have a word with you!
Hold on... W-what? What exactly is going on?
RO635 stares at ST AR-15 with confusion, but the latter merely gives her head a shake.
M4 strokes SOP-II's face and pats her on the head.
Be good, SOP-II. We'll talk later, okay?
Just give us a minute, then we can talk for as long as you want.
(Grumbles)
SOP-II still looks a bit indignant, but she is much better behaved in front of M4.
...Let's head outside. I'll explain.
After double-checking that M4 truly seems fine, she leads everyone else out of the room...
Leaving the Commander alone with the newly awakened M4.
You girls could've talked a bit more.
I'd love that, but you must have a lot of questions.
...Indeed.
I'm sure you can tell that I'm in a very peculiar state at the moment.
There are certain things that I want to keep from them so as not to cause unnecessary worry.
Hm... I am quite curious about your current state.
But more importantly... Where have you been all this time?
When confronted with this question, M4 pauses and frowns, then she shakes her head.
I'm sorry, but I can't answer that.
...You can't answer that?
That's right.
What's the meaning of this?
I hate to keep things from you, but for your sake as well as mine, I really cannot divulge that information.
I can't tell you everything right now...But please believe me—I'll never do anything that will cause you and my friends harm.
...Alright, I believe you.
Tell me only when you can.
Also, I still haven't had the chance to thank you. If it hadn't been for you, we would all have died there.
It was the least I could do, and it was also the primary reason for my return.
Of course I had to save my friends. I never expected to be thanked for such a thing.
Regardless, you still have my gratitude.
Speaking of which, how did you make it back? And where is Dandelion?
My body isn't here. Right now I'm merely a string of neural cloud data. I'm borrowing Dandelion's body for the moment, while she is asleep. There's no need to worry.
However, sustaining the presence of two neural clouds is very taxing for this body. I will have to leave when the load becomes too much for the body to bear.
I see... Wait, you have to go again?
Only after my mission is complete.
Don't worry... It won't be too long until our proper reunion.
With a smile, M4 walks up to the Commander and caresses their face.
...It must have been very hard on you, Commander.
Not at all...
Uh, by the way, we've taken the Nytos from the underground base as prisoners.
Their EW capability is too much for us to manage... Can you handle them?
No problem, leave them to me.
But your body...
I'm fine.
...Alright, then I leave the matter in your hands.
But...Please don't push yourself.
Of course. Don't worry, I'm not the way I used to be.
Not to mention... Saving her is also one of the reasons I've returned.
In the pitch-dark and silent room, all she can hear is her own breathing.
A beam of light shines through the darkness, blinding her. A cold voice snaps ruthlessly.
Wake up.
You swing by once every two hours, like clockwork.
Are we going through the same routine again? Electrocution, waterboarding, sleep deprivation... Tsk, can't you change things up a bit?
Thunk!
ST AR-15 punches Morridow on the temple.
Blood streams down from her forehead, leaving a trail down her nose.
(Wheezes) ...Is that all? I haven't had enough...
ST AR-15 gladly accepts the invitation. A knife made of alloy glints faintly in the dark as it slices through skin effortlessly.
The human body that gives Morridow such a perfect disguise comes at a price that she is paying now.
The human body feels pain.
(Coughs) Aaaargh... It hurts~! I beg you, please kill me... This is unbearable...
Ohhhh~! I want to cry! Am I allowed to cry? Will you hit me again for crying?
...Seriously, aren't you bored with this?
Morridow's exaggerated expressions vanish in an instant.
Was that good enough for you? Did you get a kick out of that? Ugh... What a drag.
Don't you know I can switch off my pain receptors? What's the point of doing this?
I'm falling asleep here.
She's deliberately trying to make you angry.
I know.
With no hesitation, ST AR-15 delivers another punch.
If she likes this game, we can humor her.
(Coughs) What, couldn't find anything you want after rummaging in my memory?
That's okay, we have plenty of time.
Ha, sure~! Heh, if it weren't for Nimogen, who would be the one being tortured now?
You? Pfft, you're not even worth the effort. A Doll core like yours is just junk to me.
It'd probably be your dear Commander... (Wheezes)
ST AR-15 kicks over Morridow's chair and steps on her face so hard it contorts.
(Coughs)
15! There's no need to waste our time on her.
Tell us the details concerning Operation Cocoon and the identity of the man known as "Father".
What answers would you like to these questions?
Let me think. Hmm... The aim of Operation Cocoon is to destroy Berlin, and Father is Kryuger! That's the name, right? Of your PMC boss...
Smack!
ST AR-15's buttstock bashes Morridow's skull. More blood flows down her cheeks.
Now it's really starting to feel like an interrogation.
But you're still too gentle.
You should get a good grip on reality—you're not going back to Paradeus.
Hahaha, you seem to have some kind of misunderstanding about Paradeus.
Oh, I forgot. You're just regular T-Dolls.
Snap! All the lights go on inside the house.
The person previously obscured by the dark now opens their eyes and watches Morridow closely.
That's it for the appetizers.
You should know that there is no meaning to your struggles.
Of course there is, but that's not for me to decide.
It all depends on you, Commander.
Go on.
We aren't actually opposites, you know.
In fact, I admire you a great deal.
Robin.
Shut up!!!
Commander, she isn't Machlian—
I am aware.
Morridow is all bloodied and beaten black and blue, but she looks utterly unperturbed, and even quirks a smile.
She slowly wriggles into a sitting position on the floor.
No, Commander, there are many things that you aren't aware of.
She wasn't my sister. To be exact, she is me, and I am her.
So?
She never told you what's the deal with us, did you?
Actually, we share memories—and emotions, even—of the same soul.
Then will you tell me what Paradeus is plotting?
When will the fireworks go off? On Unity Day?
...I'll tell you someday, but not now.
Commander stares at Morridow and lapses into silence.
ST AR-15's eyebrow twitches in rage. She lifts her rifle and is just about to beat Morridow with it again.
Hold it, 15.
M4 puts a stop to her outburst.
This is pointless. She is too resistant to pain.
...Tsk.
At least someone's got a brain here, isn't that right, Nimogen?
M4 brushes past the Commander and ST AR-15 and comes to a stop before Morridow.
You think you're playing us for fools.
But that isn't the case. The truth is... your loyalty means nothing.
I don't know what you're talking abou—
M4 places a hand on Morridow's head. The next moment...
